'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Greetings, warrior. Get over here, I've got a job for you. As you know, I deal in gear and supplies, and I've got my boys searching every corner of Tarkov for useful loot. Problem is, order are piling up, and sending them out without protection is asking for trouble. That's where you come in. Keep my boys safe along their route. Make those former PMC mercs think twice before taking a shot at them. I'll show you the route on the map. Got it? Good. Here's the catch: you've got to do it all in only a couple runs maximum. My boys won't sit around waiting if something happens to you. Don't let me down, soldier.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on daytime [[Factory]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on [[Customs]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on [[Shoreline]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on [[Reserve]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on [[Woods]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on [[Interchange]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives in [[The Lab]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on [[Ground Zero]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 EXP
* +4 [[Grenade Launchers|Grenade Launchers skill]] levels
* +4 [[Underbarrel Launchers|Underbarrel Launchers skill]] levels
* +4 [[Mag Drills|Mag Drills skill]] levels
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 400,000 Roubles
** 420,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 460,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[SR-2M Veresk 9x21 submachine gun]] (variant FSB)
* 1× [[Rys-T assault helmet (Black)]]
* 1× [[Rys-T face shield]]
* Unlocks barter for [[SR-2M Veresk 9x21 submachine gun]] (variant FSB) at [[Prapor]] LL4
* Unlocks craft for [[Rys-T assault helmet (Black)]] at [[Hideout#modules|Lavatory level 3]]
{{Quote|Ah, here is our hero! Well done, my dogs have already reported that everything went well. Thank you, really helped me out.}}

==Failure Dialogue==
{{quote|So you failed, warrior? I've been told that my guys had to get back on their own, they lost a lot of people and couldn't even find much loot either. Alright, I'll forgive you this time. The next group is packing up soon, so if you want to make amends, then go with them.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill 2 PMCs each on the specified locations in one run. Dying, disconnecting or going MIA is allowed once before the quest fails and resets.
